notes:
Hawaii's recurring entity-level levy on an operating LLC is the General Excise Tax (GET) of HRS chapter 237. HRS §237-13 levies privilege taxes annually against persons on account of their business and other activities, measured by rates against values of products, gross proceeds of sales, or gross income; HRS §237-2 defines "business" to include all activities engaged in with the object of gain or economic benefit; and the Department's own GET page says the GET "is assessed on all business activities" and "is on the business and not on the customer." That is the Washington/Ohio/Oregon gross-receipts shape recorded elsewhere in this namespace, not the Arizona transaction-privilege-tax shape: GET is not confined to enumerated transaction classifications, and the DOR's own words make the LLC's activity the subject. minimumAnnualUsd is 0 in the Washington sense - the tax is a percentage of gross income with no published floor, and an LLC with no business activity owes nothing and files nothing. The GET license is a one-time $20 registration charge, not the recurring levy, and the county GET surcharges are local levies, out of scope. collectedWithAnnualReport is false: root states.json carries annual_report_fee 12.5 for Hawaii, the Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs annual report fee, a separate payment with no overlap.
stateIncomeTax: members owe Hawaii individual income tax on pass-through income. HRS §235-51 imposes the tax on individuals; HRS §235-1 defines "corporation" by federal classification and HRS §235-71 imposes the corporate income tax on corporations, so a default partnership-taxed LLC is outside the corporate tax and its income reaches the State on the members' individual returns. The top marginal rate is 11.00% (the table for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2024, in force for 2026, applies it over $650,000; the 2027 and 2029 tables keep 11.00% as the top rate over higher thresholds). Hawaii has the pass-through entity tax of HRS §235-51.5: partnerships and S corporations may elect to pay 9% on the sum of qualified members' distributive shares and guaranteed payments, with a member credit (Act 50, SLH 2023, as amended by Act 50, SLH 2024 and Act 58, SLH 2025).
